reuse.CPU1_and_CPU4: Same frozen CPU factory/source/Numba/FP64 target dispatcher; CPU4 explicitly reuses the CPU1 compiled dispatcher. Cold CPU4 invocation is labeled JIT-reused, not independent compile.
reuse.CUDA: One context/stream and immutable factors resident. Every gradient recomputes all992 public density bands and creates a complete bound DensitySnapshot. Each call uploads full density/jobs and downloads every complete band; no output-gradient caching or omitted transfers.
reuse.owners: Three independent resident workspace owners, same exact factor/plan/input/CI/source/table identity; no simultaneous computations. Readonly referenceH/C/state/weights must retain bytes and complete complete-root certificate.

uniform fullspace derivative or optimizer speed certificate

timing.primary: Warm full raw gradient call + complete original coordinate/tangent/preconditioned metric action; includes density reconstruction, source/owner validation, band execution, required upload/download, CPU expansion/actions/full signed accumulation. No physical work removed.
timing.cold: Record ordinary setup H/CI/tracking/RDM/publicg/metric phases separately. First private g timings labeled JIT/observer scope; do not subtract totals to infer HCI.
timing.warmup_partition: Only explicit warmup calls use forward-only timers: total rawg, each next(chunks) transfer-inclusive band packet, public density/one-body if a narrow safe hook exists, original projection/metric. Remaining raw time is density/source-identity/CPU actions/signed additions jointly unless independently timed. Do not label launch-time as transfer or kernel duration.
timing.CUDA_profile: Optional owned stream CUDA-event observer on explicit warmup only: density/job uploads, two exact kernels per sixchunks and full band downloads. Observe existing operations without extra kernels, transfers or synchronization. Events read after existing syncs; failures stop. Requires concrete observer source review before seal. No events or per-kernel profiling in scored five warmtriplets.
timing.warm_band_observer: Thin packet-reference collector appends six immutable already-produced packets with identical observation on allthreebackends; comparisons/archive are after timer. No per-element comparison/copy/fsync inside primary time.
timing.archive: Same complete fields and compression/fsync cost for eachbackend, all outside primary and separately measured. No asymmetric NPZ policy.
timing.statistics: Five withintriplet CPU1/CPU4 and CPU1/CUDA ratios; median>=1.05 and every science/host/resource gate for that comparison required. CPU4 scoped efficiency=T_CPU1/(4*T_CPU4), explicitly logical-worker complete-gradient efficiency, not full nativeMCDHF parallel efficiency.
timing.score_reference_disposition: CPU1 private adapter is the scored matched reference; genuine publicf043 fullsigned g is independent correctness/ordinary phase anchor. No improvement over default publicnative solver is certified by these private-only paired statistics.

resource_count_disposition: Upper producer/request bounds, not getter-equals-newproducer assertions. Allsetup alias paths/cache-object identity need literal runner source count proof before root seal; numerical caps may not silently grow.

resources.profile_memory_source: Existing eachowner host upper196894048 bytes; ownedCUDA61409056 bytes; measured prior peak1890205696 bytes. Three persistentowners plus packet collectors require new actual RSS admission, not inferred from payload.

host_guards.root_window: ReserveCPU28..31 andGPU; no other numerical, browser or timer-launched probes overlapping. Existing source benchmark idleFAIL remains.

gates.point_admission: Fresh genuine public owner/HCI at samepoint vs complete savedroot/H/CI/UID/signednormtable identity; source geometry nucleus operator unchanged.
gates.per_trial: Owner/input/H/C/table/metric byte identity before and after; all2824 bands vs ordinary reference, complete31x246/raw3689/tangent/pg originalgates. Complete H roots/residual/Gram/signed-spans verified once at admission and repeated array-byte identity prevents dropping a changed CI; if opting full residual/Gram repeats, count and archive validation time separately.

gates.host_failure: Keep correctness and allobservations, controlledspeed=false. No automatic warm rerun, no alpha/seed/ns/weights/gate change.

decision.if_CPU_actions_identity_density_dominate: Prioritize exact same-argument CPUaction/bandexpansion/RDM/identity reuse; keep allsignedterms. Do not enlarge GPU scope based on isolatedscan speed.
decision.if_band_block_dominates: Only then consider resident action/reduction proposal, with original signed sumorder/FP64/target/metric proofs; not part of this benchmark.
decision.if_H_CI_dominates: Measure real native31 accepted-step HCI-to-gradient count before choosing production route. The onepoint frozen-gradient speed result is not end-to-end MCDHF.
decision.scoped_maximum_gain: Report measured band-time fraction and Amdahl bounds only within this resident rawgradient chain, not entire optimization.

stop: No execution without concrete literal executor/input/counter source review and exact root seal. Any physical/source/owner drift or CUDA/resource/science failure retains firstfailedphase and stops. Host guard failure may retain observations only. No dependency install/publicsource/default/registry/timer/adoption edits.
